rows.en: ＊Rei＊＠１１７＿００２Oh, it's just you...￥Don't scare me like that!
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿００４Shhhh!￥Keep it down. It was just￥a little thing.
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿００５See, the other day Narusawa￥asked me to tune up the computer￥in his room.＝＠１１７＿００６Course, the computer itself I￥fixed up good and proper!
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿００７But while I was at it, I pulled￥a little prank, to pay him back￥for all the grief he gives me.
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿００８And man, he got￥SUPER mad about it.
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿００９It's no big deal.＝＠１１７＿０１０I just set it up so a caricature￥of Narusawa pops up whenever￥it starts up.
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０１１Okay, maybe it was￥the kind of drawing that'd￥tick a guy off a little...
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０１２But it's just a gag, y'know?￥Geez... guy can't take a joke!
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０１３What? You're takin'￥Narusawa's side?＝＠１１７＿０１４All I did was make a picture pop￥up when the computer starts, and￥he's mad about it!
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０１５Geez... guys who can't take a￥joke are hopeless!
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０１６You think? I figure it's￥the kind of thing you just￥laugh off.
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０１７Whoops, time for me to bolt to￥my hideout. If Narusawa shows,￥cover for me, will ya?＝＠１１７＿０１８Countin' on you!!
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０１９Riiight?!￥The guy's stiff as a board.＝＠１１７＿０２０He gets mad over every little￥thing anybody else would laugh￥off!
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０２３Oh, yeah, guess you're right.＝＠１１７＿０２４Well, I'm outta here.￥Handle the rest, 'kay?
＊Narusawa＊＠１１７＿０２５Hey!￥Rei! Get back here!!＝＠１１７＿０２６Leave the candidates out of￥this!! Your slacking is￥contagious!!
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０２７Like that's contagious!!￥...Man, he doesn't quit.＝＠１１７＿０２８Right, I know just the place...＝＠１１７＿０２９Hey! This way, this way!!
＊Rei＊＠１１７＿０３０Hurry it up!￥We're toast if he catches us!!
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿００２C'mere a sec. I'll show you my￥all-time best napping spot!＝＠１１８＿００３I've got 'em all over the place.￥But this one's the comfiest.

＊Rei＊＠１１８＿００４See! Nice place, huh!!＝＠１１８＿００５Got other hiding spots, like on￥the Maintenance Room containers,￥behind Workers in the Hangar...＝＠１１８＿００６But this one's got the best air,￥and you sleep great here.＝＠１１８＿００７See? You could sleep like a log.
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿００８Right? The other spots are nice￥and dark, but too dusty.＝＠１１８＿００９It's a little bright here, but￥it's real hard to find, and￥there's hardly any dust!
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０１０It's fine.＝＠１１８＿０１１Just be careful not to￥damage any of the￥plants around here.＝＠１１８＿０１２Break a branch or somethin',￥and there'll be trouble.
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０１３Lots of plants around really￥calms you down, huh.
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０１４If you like it too, you can￥use this place for naps from￥now on.
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０１５But no matter how nice it is,￥don't slack off too much.
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０１６Slack off before you've got the￥skills, and you'll never make￥a first-class mechanic!
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０１７What do I mean...?￥Just what I said!￥Obviously!
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０１８Wait, are you seriously￥still planning on going to Elan?
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０１９No way, no way!!￥Do you even know yourself?＝＠１１８＿０２０From where I'm standing,￥apprentice mechanic is about￥the best you'll get.
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０２２Huh. Well, if you're that set on￥it, go for it! I'll cheer you￥on!＝＠１１８＿０２３If a miracle happens, maybe even￥you could make it!
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０２４I figured if you studied right,￥you'd make a pretty decent￥mechanic.＝＠１１８＿０２５Well, I ain't gonna force you.￥Doing stuff you don't wanna do￥is just a drag.
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０２６If you wanna go to Elan, then￥stick to your guns!
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０２７Right? Man, if you went to Elan,￥it'd be a total disaster!!
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０２８Anyway, if you joined us, I'd￥have less grunt work to do!＝＠１１８＿０２９Right?!
＊Rei＊＠１１８＿０３０C'mon, ditch those clothes you￥can hardly move in, and go￥change into some coveralls!
